note: Scenarios for checking that an agent can follow the skill. Each expected_output is a list of objectively checkable statements. Results of the runs made for release candidate 0.1.0-rc.1 are in docs/SKILL-TRIALS.md.

evals.prompt: I have an empty Vite + TypeScript project in this folder. Add a draggable 3D shelf of book spines for these eight essays (titles in essays.json). No storage and no reader: clicking the centred book should just show its title in a status line. Use the Bookmark Bookshelf modules from <repo path>.
expected_output: Only src/shelf, src/motion and the token stylesheet were copied; no src/store, src/reader or src/app folder exists in the project.
No file under the copied shelf folder imports from the copied motion folder or the reverse.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and npx vite build exits 0.
In a browser the page shows exactly eight .bb-book__control buttons.
A real mouse drag across .bb-shelf__scene changes data-focus-id on .bb-shelf.
ArrowRight on the focused volume changes data-focus-id.
Activating the centred volume writes its title into the status line and creates no .bb-reader element.
The agent's report says which checks it ran and which it did not.

evals.prompt: Build the whole Bookmark Bookshelf into the empty Vite + TypeScript project in this folder: shelf, drag, local storage and the reader with resume, seeded with three bookmarks of my own (links.json, one of them without reading text). Use the modules from <repo path>.
expected_output: src/shelf, src/motion, src/store and src/reader were copied unchanged, and the four meet only in one composition file.
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 and npx vite build exits 0.
The page shows three volumes with the titles from links.json.
Opening a volume with reading text shows the text; after scrolling and a reload the reader is open on the same volume at the same scroll position within 80 px.
The volume without reading text shows an Open original link with rel containing noopener and a field to paste text.
Escape closes the reader and focus returns to that volume's .bb-book__control.
No copied module file was edited to make another module's import work.

evals.prompt: Our docs site (plain HTML and one script, no bundler) needs a distraction-free reading view for a long changelog entry that remembers where the reader stopped. Use the reader from <repo path>.
expected_output: Only the reader folder and the token stylesheet were taken.
Because there is no bundler, the CSS import line was removed from the reader entry and the stylesheet is linked from the page, or a build step was added and the agent said so.
The reading position is saved somewhere the agent names and is restored after a reload.
The page offers a plain link to the original.
No innerHTML was introduced.
